instructions.task: Our annotation policy covers hate speech, mainly against women and immigrants (including refugees, migrants, asylum seekers, Muslims coming in, 'illegal aliens'), and also against other groups by race or religion. A tweet is hateful when it expresses hatred, contempt, dehumanisation, threats, or blanket exclusion against such a group or against an individual woman, either as a group or as an individual targeted as a member of the group. Which description fits this tweet best?
notes: The word bitch or hoe alone does not make a tweet hateful. Addressing a friend as 'bitch' in an exclamation, joke, question or banter is not hateful.
Using bitch/hoe/whore/cunt hostilely to insult or attack a specific woman, or generalising about women as hoes/bitches, is hateful.
Insulting a man (e.g. calling a male pundit a 'Trump bitch', or calling a guy who keeps switching girls a 'burnt out hoe') is not hate against women.

Demanding that immigrants/refugees be kept out or go home (e.g. #NoImmigrants #NoRefugees, 'deport every illegal alien', 'go home', banning people from whole countries), calling them invaders, portraying them as criminals or a burden, or as bringing lawlessness and third-world decay, is hateful.

Merely sharing slogans or hashtags (#BuildTheWall, #SendThemBack, #StopTheInvasion) with no statement about immigrants, arguing about terminology ('illegal alien is the correct term'), or making a political/legal argument about immigration and elections, is not hateful.
Racist generalisations about black people or other races or religions are hateful.
Opposing DACA or amnesty in a way that wants Dreamers or illegal immigrants deported or removed (#NoDACA #NoAmnesty with deportation, #gohome #sendthemback endorsing removal) is hateful.
Reposting a crime news headline about an immigrant with a wall hashtag, without further comment about immigrants, is not hateful; nor is #SendThemBack used about non-immigration topics.
Supportive or affectionate tweets to a friend that use 'bitch' (e.g. 'Bitch stfu, whoever says that can kick rocks') are not hateful; putting down other women as hoes or bitches is.
Attacking a politician or public figure (e.g. calling her a traitor) while adding immigration hashtags is not hate unless it demeans immigrants or women as such.
